assertions.name: silver_pole_genuine_and_subdominant
assertions.source: Q_A(silver)=0 ∧ Δ(net)(silver)≠0 (genuine pole); u_silver>u_substrate (subdominant char root 3.12 vs 117.4)

description: Corrects PR #2445's dominance claim: the silver/Q_A zero IS a genuine pole of F=Q_β/[Q_A·cos α_eff] (Δ(net)(silver)=82216+58136√2≠0 while Q_A(silver)=0; the true Q_β uses GB-reduced Δ(net), not the cheat-sheet leading term≈Q_A — that check was circular). But it is SUBDOMINANT: u_silver≈0.321 → char root ≈3.12, not the dominant 1/u_substrate≈117.4 (PR #1727). The dominant pole is from a non-Q_A source. NO FLOAT. Exploratory.
